name: Baidu, Inc.
sector: Communication Services / Internet Search, AI Cloud & Autonomous Driving (China)
moat_justification: China's incumbent search engine with a full AI stack (ERNIE models, AI Cloud/GPU cloud, Apollo Go robotaxis) and fortress liquidity, but the search-ad moat is eroding fast: advertisers and attention are shifting to short-video and super-app platforms, AI search itself cannibalizes ad monetization (management deliberately delayed it), cloud competes with Alibaba/Tencent/Huawei on price, and China/VIE/regulatory overhang is structural. AI-powered business reached 50% of Baidu General Business revenue in Q2 2026 and AI Cloud Infra grew 50% YoY, yet total revenue fell 4% YoY and online marketing fell 19% YoY in the same quarter — the new engines are not yet outrunning the legacy decline. A 5 gives CAP 8.5 years.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency CNY converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion
USD_TRANSLATIONS_USED: the issuer files its own USD convenience translations alongside its reporting currency; the engine used the filed USD figures

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x8.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-17): cover page registers American depositary shares each representing eight Class A ordinary shares, the Introduction defines ADSs the same way, and the EPS table states 1 ADS equals 8 Class A ordinary shares) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:shares — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-17), Consolidated Statements of Comprehensive Income, EPS section: weighted average number of Class A and Class B ordinary shares outstanding (in millions) — diluted 2,744 for FY2025, with 2,798 for FY2024 and 2,837 for FY2023 in the same table); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share -7.80 vs 3-yr median 3.32 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.4x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: China search incumbent in an AI transition, moat 5/10 — does not clear 15% on any scenario: weighted IRR 6.27% (Tier D), IV@15% $24.86 vs $81.86 price on the normalized median base OE of $3.32/ADS (FY2025 OE/share was -$7.80 after operating cash flow turned negative); even the super-bull case yields only 10.90% — it clears 15% only below ~$24.86.
moat_for: Incumbent China search distribution and advertiser base, now being rebuilt as AI search (ERNIE Assistant daily users +83% YoY in Q2 2026)
Full-stack AI position: ERNIE foundation models, AI Cloud Infra revenue +50% YoY in Q2 2026 with GPU Cloud +283% YoY, plus Kunlunxin chips
Apollo Go robotaxi scale: 1 million fully driverless rides in Q2 2026, cumulative rides over 23 million, expanding internationally
Fortress liquidity: cash and investments of RMB283.1 billion at June 30, 2026 (Q2 2026 results), funding AI capex, a $5B buyback through 2028 and a first dividend policy without balance-sheet stress
Buyback tailwind: diluted weighted-average ordinary shares fell from 2,837M (FY2023) to 2,744M (FY2025) in the 20-F EPS table
moat_against: Legacy search advertising is in structural decline: online marketing services revenue -19% YoY in Q2 2026 (-22% in Q1 2026), as budgets shift to Douyin/short video, Xiaohongshu and super-apps
AI search cannibalizes its own ad model: management deliberately delayed AI-search monetization, and total revenue fell in FY2025 (-3% in RMB) and again in Q1/Q2 2026
Cloud and models are contested, not owned: Alibaba, Tencent, Huawei and ByteDance compete on price and distribution; ERNIE's model lead must be re-earned each generation
China/VIE/regulatory overhang: VIE structure, PRC data and platform regulation, US ADS delisting tail risk, and a 2026 US securities class action over AI-revenue disclosures
Controlled, cash-hungry subsidiaries and investments: iQIYI revenue -5% YoY in Q2 2026 with a working-capital deficit disclosed in the 20-F; FY2025 group operating cash flow turned negative

overrides.source: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-17), Consolidated Statements of Comprehensive Income, EPS section: weighted average number of Class A and Class B ordinary shares outstanding (in millions) — diluted 2,744 for FY2025, with 2,798 for FY2024 and 2,837 for FY2023 in the same table
